sql.query: SELECT CAST(CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tbl_user_tenant_roles utr INNER JOIN tbl_roles r ON r.id=utr.roleId AND r.isActive=1 AND r.roleKey IN ('owner','admin') WHERE utr.userId=:adminUserId AND utr.tenantId=:adminTenantId AND utr.isActive=1) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tbl_tasks t INNER JOIN tbl_user_tenants ut ON ut.userId=:userId AND ut.tenantId=t.tenantId AND ut.isActive=1 AND ut.membershipStatus='active' INNER JOIN tbl_team_members tm ON tm.userTenantId=ut.id AND tm.tenantId=t.tenantId AND tm.teamId=CASE WHEN SUBSTRING_INDEX(:assignmentType,':',1)='team' THEN CAST(NULLIF(SUBSTRING_INDEX(:assignmentTeam,':',-1),'') AS UNSIGNED) ELSE t.assignedToTeamId END AND tm.isActive=1 INNER JOIN tbl_team_member_roles tmr ON tmr.teamMemberId=tm.id AND tmr.isActive=1 INNER JOIN tbl_team_role_permissions trp ON trp.teamRoleId=tmr.teamRoleId INNER JOIN tbl_permissions p ON p.id=trp.permissionId AND p.permissionCode='team.tasks.assign' AND p.isActive=1 WHERE t.id=:taskId AND t.tenantId=:tenantId) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS UNSIGNED) allowed

data.message: Only a tenant Owner, tenant Admin, Team Manager or Team Leader can allocate this task.

sql.query: SELECT id,workflowId,taskName,status,priority,assignedToUserId,assignedToTeamId,dueDate,locationMode,locationId,spaceId,configurationId FROM tbl_tasks WHERE id=:id AND tenantId=:tenantId LIMIT 1

UPDATE tbl_tasks t SET t.taskName=:taskName,t.description=:description,t.status=:status,t.priority=:priority,t.isRequired=:isRequired,t.assignedToUserId=CASE WHEN SUBSTRING_INDEX(:assignment1,':',1)='team' THEN (SELECT ut.userId FROM tbl_team_members tm INNER JOIN tbl_user_tenants ut ON ut.id=tm.userTenantId AND ut.tenantId=tm.tenantId AND ut.isActive=1 AND ut.membershipStatus='active' INNER JOIN tbl_users u ON u.id=ut.userId AND u.isActive=1 WHERE tm.tenantId=t.tenantId AND tm.teamId=CAST(NULLIF(SUBSTRING_INDEX(:assignment2,':',-1),'') AS UNSIGNED) AND tm.isActive=1 AND ut.userId=NULLIF(:assignedUserId,'') LIMIT 1) ELSE NULL END,t.assignedToTeamId=CASE WHEN SUBSTRING_INDEX(:assignment3,':',1)='team' THEN CAST(NULLIF(SUBSTRING_INDEX(:assignment4,':',-1),'') AS UNSIGNED) ELSE NULL END,t.assignedToRoleId=NULL,t.dueDate=NULLIF(:dueDate,''),t.startedDate=CASE WHEN :status2='in_progress' THEN COALESCE(t.startedDate,CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) ELSE t.startedDate END,t.completedDate=CASE WHEN :status3='complete' THEN COALESCE(t.completedDate,CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) ELSE NULL END,t.completedByUserId=CASE WHEN :status4='complete' THEN :userId ELSE NULL END,t.modifiedDate=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,t.rowVersion=t.rowVersion+1 WHERE t.id=:id AND t.tenantId=:tenantId AND t.rowVersion=:rowVersion AND (:status5<>'complete' OR (((t.requiredSnapshot=0) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tbl_task_answers a WHERE a.taskId=t.id AND a.tenantId=t.tenantId AND CASE t.answerTypeSnapshot WHEN 'yes_no' THEN a.answerBoolean IS NOT NULL WHEN 'task_status' THEN NULLIF(TRIM(a.answerStatus),'') IS NOT NULL WHEN 'radio' THEN NULLIF(TRIM(a.answerOptionValue),'') IS NOT NULL WHEN 'dropdown_single' THEN NULLIF(TRIM(a.answerOptionValue),'') IS NOT NULL WHEN 'checkbox_multi' THEN JSON_LENGTH(COALESCE(a.answerJson,JSON_ARRAY()))>0 WHEN 'dropdown_multi' THEN JSON_LENGTH(COALESCE(a.answerJson,JSON_ARRAY()))>0 WHEN 'text_short' THEN NULLIF(TRIM(a.answerText),'') IS NOT NULL WHEN 'text_long' THEN NULLIF(TRIM(a.answerText),'') IS NOT NULL ELSE 0 END)) AND (t.attachmentRequirement<>'required' OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tbl_documents d WHERE d.taskId=t.id AND d.tenantId=t.tenantId))))

data.message: Another user changed this task after you opened it. Your changes were not saved. Reload the latest task and try again.

sql.query: INSERT INTO tbl_notifications (tenantId,userId,workflowId,taskId,notificationType,title,message,status,channel,createdDate) SELECT t.tenantId,t.assignedToUserId,t.workflowId,t.id,'task_assigned',CONCAT('Task assigned: ',t.taskName),CONCAT(:actor,' assigned this task to you.'),'unread','in_app',CURRENT_TIMESTAMP FROM tbl_tasks t WHERE t.id=:taskId AND t.tenantId=:tenantId AND t.assignedToUserId IS NOT NULL AND t.assignedToUserId<>:actorUserId AND COALESCE(t.assignedToUserId,0)<>COALESCE(:oldAssignedUserId,0)

INSERT INTO tbl_notifications (tenantId,userId,workflowId,taskId,notificationType,title,message,status,channel,createdDate) SELECT t.tenantId,ut.userId,t.workflowId,t.id,'task_assigned',CONCAT('Team task assigned: ',t.taskName),CONCAT(:actor,' assigned this task to your team.'),'unread','in_app',CURRENT_TIMESTAMP FROM tbl_tasks t INNER JOIN tbl_team_members tm ON tm.teamId=t.assignedToTeamId AND tm.tenantId=t.tenantId AND tm.isActive=1 INNER JOIN tbl_user_tenants ut ON ut.id=tm.userTenantId AND ut.tenantId=t.tenantId AND ut.isActive=1 AND ut.membershipStatus='active' WHERE t.id=:taskId AND t.tenantId=:tenantId AND t.assignedToTeamId IS NOT NULL AND t.assignedToTeamId<>:oldAssignedTeamId AND ut.userId<>:actorUserId AND (t.assignedToUserId IS NULL OR ut.userId<>t.assignedToUserId)

UPDATE tbl_tasks t SET t.locationMode=CASE WHEN :locationMode='override' THEN 'override' ELSE 'inherit' END,t.locationId=CASE WHEN :locationMode2='override' THEN (SELECT l.id FROM tbl_locations l WHERE l.id=NULLIF(:locationId,'') AND l.tenantId=t.tenantId LIMIT 1) ELSE NULL END,t.spaceId=CASE WHEN :locationMode3='override' THEN (SELECT s.id FROM tbl_spaces s WHERE s.id=NULLIF(:spaceId,'') AND s.locationId=NULLIF(:locationId2,'') AND s.tenantId=t.tenantId LIMIT 1) ELSE NULL END,t.configurationId=CASE WHEN :locationMode4='override' THEN (SELECT c.id FROM tbl_space_configurations c WHERE c.id=NULLIF(:configurationId,'') AND c.spaceId=NULLIF(:spaceId2,'') AND c.tenantId=t.tenantId LIMIT 1) ELSE NULL END WHERE t.id=:id AND t.tenantId=:tenantId
SELECT locationMode,locationId,spaceId,configurationId FROM tbl_tasks WHERE id=:id AND tenantId=:tenantId LIMIT 1

INSERT INTO tbl_activity_log (tenantId,userId,workflowId,taskId,entityType,entityId,actionType,summary,beforeJson,afterJson,createdDate) SELECT :tenantId,:userId,:workflowId,:taskId,'task',:entityId,'task.location_changed',CONCAT(:actor,' changed the location setting for ',:taskName),JSON_OBJECT('locationMode',:oldMode,'locationId',:oldLocation,'spaceId',:oldSpace,'configurationId',:oldConfiguration),JSON_OBJECT('locationMode',:newMode,'locationId',:newLocation,'spaceId',:newSpace,'configurationId',:newConfiguration),CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE COALESCE(:oldMode2,'')<>COALESCE(:newMode2,'') OR COALESCE(:oldLocation2,0)<>COALESCE(:newLocation2,0) OR COALESCE(:oldSpace2,0)<>COALESCE(:newSpace2,0) OR COALESCE(:oldConfiguration2,0)<>COALESCE(:newConfiguration2,0)

INSERT INTO tbl_activity_log (tenantId,userId,workflowId,taskId,entityType,entityId,actionType,summary,beforeJson,afterJson,createdDate) SELECT :tenantId,:userId,:workflowId,:taskId,'task',:entityId,CASE WHEN :oldTeam<>:newTeam THEN 'task.team_changed' WHEN :oldStatus<>:newStatus THEN 'task.status_changed' ELSE 'task.updated' END,CASE WHEN :oldTeam2<>:newTeam2 THEN CONCAT(:actor,' changed the team for ',:taskName) WHEN :oldStatus2<>:newStatus2 THEN CONCAT(:actor,' changed ',:taskName2,' from ',REPLACE(:oldStatus3,'_',' '),' to ',REPLACE(:newStatus3,'_',' ')) ELSE CONCAT(:actor,' updated ',:taskName3) END,JSON_OBJECT('taskName',:oldName,'status',:oldStatus4,'priority',:oldPriority,'teamId',:oldTeam3,'dueDate',:oldDue),JSON_OBJECT('taskName',:newName,'status',:newStatus4,'priority',:newPriority,'teamId',:newTeam3,'dueDate',:newDue),CURRENT_TIMESTAMP FROM tbl_activity_types at WHERE at.tenantId=:tenantId2 AND at.activityKey=CASE WHEN :oldTeam4<>:newTeam4 THEN 'task.team_changed' WHEN :oldStatus5<>:newStatus5 THEN 'task.status_changed' ELSE 'task.updated' END AND at.isActive=1 LIMIT 1
